import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int t = 1; // As in the original code, t is set to 1
        while (t-- > 0) {
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            int n = s.length();
            StringBuilder str = new StringBuilder();
            str.append(s.charAt(0));
            int flag = 0;
            int i = 1;
            while (i < n) {
                if (flag == 0 && i < n - 2) {
                    String s1 = s.substring(i, Math.min(i + 2, n));
                    if (s1.equals("at")) {
                        str.append('@');
                        i += 2;
                        flag++;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                if (i + 3 <= n) {
                    String s1 = s.substring(i, i + 3);
                    if (s1.equals("dot")) {
                        str.append('.');
                        i += 3;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                str.append(s.charAt(i));
                i++;
            }
            System.out.println(str.toString());
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
